programmes.d: A recent college graduate and his foster brother turn to their faith to overcome challenges and obstacles.
Lydia Ellis must keep her family afloat after her husband, a depressed former NFL player who was sidelined by a career-ending injury, loses faith and leaves home.
The pastor of a Baptist church has a dark secret that could cost him everything. He realizes everyone needs to be preached to -- including himself.

Getting out of rehab, losing his girlfriend, and the death of his mother; life has been rough for Travis. Determined to fix his life, Travis gets sober. That is until he meets, Pearl, a girl more dangerous than his addictions.

College student, Quan, is presented with an opportunity too good to turn down. When she lets her sister, Bree, in on the deal, she takes it to the next level. Soon Quan realizes they both are in too deep, and is faced with the consequences.
Jeremy is held back from his dream of being a news anchor by his friends and his lack of focus until he realigns his life by finding faith in God and himself.
A one-night stand leads to life-changing consequences for a man and woman.

Harmony is on the verge of being dropped from her record label; her manager, suggests she returns to Atlanta to refresh her sound; she must reunite with her mother and is forced to face her childhood trauma.

Ten years after a liquor store robbery left their sister dead and their father shattered, prosecutor Larissa and her sister Maritza, a top trauma nurse, are ready to take justice into their own hands.

Mark Lewisohn shares stories and revelations about the year that changed The Beatles' fortunes and music forever - 1962 - offering fresh insight into the innovative and ever-popular band that transformed culture worldwide.
After fleeing under a new identity following a suspected double murder, a man's quiet life in Florida unravels as neighbors probe his past.

A young couple's experiment in intimacy spirals into a nightmare when they invite a seductive stranger into their home. Little do they know, she's a killer on the loose, and their lives hang by a thread

Diamond White, a college graduate drowning in debt and raising his younger sister, turns to dancing for survival; after moving to Texas, he joins Midnight, an underground male club and quickly rises to the top.
